lens: Member evaluator — cross-step continuity (simulated AI lens)
reason: The public proposition and supplied desktop/mobile hero captures are clear and coherent with Precision Instrument. Source tracing of My work → calibration → observation entry → saved evidence → return to My work exposes a material completion-status contradiction and a note-only persistence gap. Standard evaluations have useful readiness checks, explicit not-observed choices, review-before-lock and receipt validation; those strengths do not carry consistently into Group Case. Local SQL tests protect scoring validity, but do not establish evaluator task success. This is an independent AI source/evidence assessment, not a human usability observation or hosted acceptance result.

findings.evidence: isSubmitted at lines 27-29 treats any SUBMITTED record as complete; lines 250-251 tell that reviewer the evaluation is locked, and lines 299-310 list finished work. Yet rate_group_case_applicant in migration 20261016191000, lines 308-339, marks even a one-star partial save SUBMITTED and permits subsequent updates. GroupCaseRoster shows only Started grading and dimensions rated, without canonical validity blockers. SQL tests at grading_contract_consistency.sql:85-112 explicitly demonstrate invalid saved one-star and insufficient-coverage evaluations.
findings.userImpact: A reviewer returning from Group Case can see incomplete, still-editable evidence described as finished and locked, obscuring both remaining observations and the route to correct them.
findings.suggestedFix: Carry canonical saved/partial/valid/locked state into the roster and My work. Show missing requirements and a continue-grading link; reserve locked copy for an actual frozen/locked evaluation. Verify one-star save → return → resume → valid → freeze continuity.

findings.evidence: editNote at lines 195-203 returns without saving when no score exists; flushNote at lines 206-210 also requires a score. Calibration lines 92-98 instruct members to note flags regardless of score. The SQL fixture at grading_contract_consistency.sql:70-80 verifies that note-only evidence can be saved without counting as valid.
findings.userImpact: A reviewer with a useful qualitative observation but insufficient scoring evidence must invent a rating or leave the note unsaved; navigating away loses that observation.
findings.suggestedFix: Persist nonblank note-only observations with null scores, show their save receipt and partial status, and cover typing a flag with every dimension unobserved followed by navigation and restoration.
